map.每次进刀需对刀基准一致，螺距 1.5mm 对应主轴每转刀架走 1.5mm；乱扣多: Each pass needs a consistent tool-reference; pitch 1.5mm means the toolpost advances 1.5mm per spindle revolution; mismatch is usually from not lifting the half-nut on retract or encoder step loss.
map.车螺纹转速怎么定？: How to set the thread-turning speed?
map.由 vc 与直径算，小直径可高转；但需保证走刀与螺距同步，高转速时系统响应要跟得: Compute from vc and diameter; small diameters can run at high rpm; but ensure feed-to-pitch synchronization, with system response keeping up at high speed.
map.公制三角螺纹 d2 = d−0.6495P 是标准 60° 牙型近似，英制/梯形: The metric triangular-thread d2 = d−0.6495P is the standard 60° profile approximation; inch / trapezoidal threads use different coefficients and need their respective standards.
map.螺纹加工方案工具，根据螺纹规格、材料、加工方向和批量，推荐适合的螺纹加工方法（车: The thread-machining scheme tool recommends a suitable thread-machining method (turning / tapping / milling / rolling) from thread specification, material, machining direction and batch, and computes spindle speed, pitch diameter, minor diameter and other parameters.
map.螺纹加工参数与方案（本页代码口径）：主轴转速 n=1000×Vc÷(π×d)（r: Thread machining parameters and options (code basis of this page): spindle speed n=1000×Vc÷(π×d) (rpm; Vc is looked up by material — carbon steel 60/alloy steel 45/stainless steel 30/cast iron 70/aluminum alloy 120/brass 90); pitch diameter d₂=d−0.64952×P, external thread root d₃=d−1.22687×P (basic minor diameter d−1.08253×P), internal thread minor diameter D₁=d−1.08253×P, tapping pilot hole=d−P (mm). Validation: non-numeric or ≤0 diameter or pitch prompts "Please enter a valid nominal diameter/pitch" for each and stops. Criterion: external threads prefer turning (6g/4h), add rolling (6g) for high volume, add milling for non-one-off production; internal threads prefer tapping (Vc×0.6), add internal milling when d≥20, then internal turning (Vc×0.7).
